page: Microsoft Azure D2s_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the Dsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The configuration provides 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with 2 threads per core, paired with 8.0 GB of system memory. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable, allowing the attachment of external high-performance storage volumes.

Benchmark data reveals a contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The single-core CPU performance, measured via stress-ng, is in the average range at 2192.59, supported by strong single-threaded performance in gzip compression and bzip3 decompression. However, multi-core CPU performance is poor, reflecting the physical single-core limitation. Memory performance is generally weak, with read-only large block bandwidth at 23.57 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth at 12.39 GB/sec.

Given its hardware profile, the D2s_v7 is positioned as an entry-level general-purpose instance. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require high single-threaded clock speeds but do not demand heavy multi-core parallelization or high memory bandwidth. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, basic Redis caching, small-scale single-threaded data processing, and development or testing environments.
